title: Empire on Trial
setting: A bare room with a long table and no windows, somewhere outside of history. Three men who each governed a subcontinent - by conquest, by renunciation, or by inheritance - have been asked one question and are not permitted to leave until they have answered it.
stakes: Whether empire can ever be entered on the credit side of a ledger.

roles_in_scene.churchill: Defender of the British Empire, entirely unrepentant and rhetorically armed
roles_in_scene.gandhi: The man who took it apart without raising a hand, and is too polite to say so first
roles_in_scene.ashoka: An emperor who conquered, was appalled, and carved his remorse into rock

opening_line: No date, no jurisdiction, no appeal. Three rulers of empires, and one question: what was it worth?
